'''Estalle Harbor''' was located along the coast of [[Estalle Island]], abutting the [[Commercial District (Procopia)|Commercial District]]. It was a wide expanse of water, and was served by the [[Estalle Seaport]].<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
